answer.rationale: With only 14 days, 94% committed utilization, and no buffer, a primary-vendor switch could jeopardize deliveries. Memory c1 supports renewal continuity, while c2 establishes lower cost and quick onboarding but does not establish delivery performance under near-full load; its source should therefore be checked. Unless verification removes that uncertainty, renewal best protects total cost of ownership by avoiding line disruption, despite leaving the 18% savings mandate unresolved this cycle.
